[問：若爾，復違《寶性論》說，云：「向說闡提常不入涅槃，無涅槃性者，為欲迴轉誹謗大乘心，不求大乘心故，依無量時，故如是說，以彼實有清淨性故。」《佛性論》云「言有性者，是顯了說；言無性者，是不了說」，乃至「故佛觀一切眾生有自性清淨故，後時決定得清淨法身」。准此故知，無闡提人無佛性者，亦無有情不成佛者。](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/295%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9A%E7%8E%8B%20%E7%A9%86%E6%8F%90%20.md#%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B#%E5%95%8F%EF%BC%9A%E8%8B%A5%E7%88%BE%EF%BC%8C%E5%BE%A9%E9%81%95%E3%80%8A%E5%AF%B6%E6%80%A7%E8%AB%96%E3%80%8B%E8%AA%AA%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%91%EF%BC%9A%E3%80%8C%E5%90%91%E8%AA%AA%E9%97%A1%E6%8F%90%E5%B8%B8%E4%B8%8D%E5%85%A5%E6%B6%85%E6%A7%83%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E6%B6%85%E6%A7%83%E6%80%A7%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E7%82%BA%E6%AC%B2%E8%BF%B4%E8%BD%89%E8%AA%B9%E8%AC%97%E5%A4%A7%E4%B9%98%E5%BF%83%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%8D%E6%B1%82%E5%A4%A7%E4%B9%98%E5%BF%83%E6%95%85%EF%BC%8C%E4%BE%9D%E7%84%A1%E9%87%8F%E6%99%82%EF%BC%8C%E6%95%85%E5%A6%82%E6%98%AF%E8%AA%AA%EF%BC%8C%E4%BB%A5%E5%BD%BC%E5%AF%A6%E6%9C%89%E6%B8%85%E6%B7%A8%E6%80%A7%E6%95%85%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D%E3%80%8A%E4%BD%9B%E6%80%A7%E8%AB%96%E3%80%8B%E4%BA%91%E3%80%8C%E8%A8%80%E6%9C%89%E6%80%A7%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E6%98%AF%E9%A1%AF%E4%BA%86%E8%AA%AA%EF%BC%9B%E8%A8%80%E7%84%A1%E6%80%A7%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%8D%E4%BA%86%E8%AA%AA%E3%80%8D%EF%BC%8C%E4%B9%83%E8%87%B3%E3%80%8C%E6%95%85%E4%BD%9B%E8%A7%80%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E7%9C%BE%E7%94%9F%E6%9C%89%E8%87%AA%E6%80%A7%E6%B8%85%E6%B7%A8%E6%95%85%EF%BC%8C%E5%BE%8C%E6%99%82%E6%B1%BA%E5%AE%9A%E5%BE%97%E6%B8%85%E6%B7%A8%E6%B3%95%E8%BA%AB%E3%80%8D%E3%80%82%E5%87%86%E6%AD%A4%E6%95%85%E7%9F%A5%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E9%97%A1%E6%8F%90%E4%BA%BA%E7%84%A1%E4%BD%9B%E6%80%A7%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%A6%E7%84%A1%E6%9C%89%E6%83%85%E4%B8%8D%E6%88%90%E4%BD%9B%E8%80%85%E3%80%82)

[問曰：過去、未來不應受樂，現在心一念住時應受樂，云何言不受？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/295%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9A%E7%8E%8B%20%E7%A9%86%E6%8F%90%20.md#%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B#%E5%95%8F%E6%9B%B0%EF%BC%9A%E9%81%8E%E5%8E%BB%E3%80%81%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E4%B8%8D%E6%87%89%E5%8F%97%E6%A8%82%EF%BC%8C%E7%8F%BE%E5%9C%A8%E5%BF%83%E4%B8%80%E5%BF%B5%E4%BD%8F%E6%99%82%E6%87%89%E5%8F%97%E6%A8%82%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%91%E4%BD%95%E8%A8%80%E4%B8%8D%E5%8F%97%EF%BC%9F)
            185. [問曰：若空不可得盡度者，少亦俱空，何以度少？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/295%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9A%E7%8E%8B%20%E7%A9%86%E6%8F%90%20.md#%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B#%E5%95%8F%E6%9B%B0%EF%BC%9A%E8%8B%A5%E7%A9%BA%E4%B8%8D%E5%8F%AF%E5%BE%97%E7%9B%A1%E5%BA%A6%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E5%B0%91%E4%BA%A6%E4%BF%B1%E7%A9%BA%EF%BC%8C%E4%BD%95%E4%BB%A5%E5%BA%A6%E5%B0%91%EF%BC%9F)
            186. [問曰：若爾者，如迦葉問中，佛說：「我是一邊，無我是一邊，離此二邊，名為中道。」今云何言無我是實，有我為方便說？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/295%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9A%E7%8E%8B%20%E7%A9%86%E6%8F%90%20.md#%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B#%E5%95%8F%E6%9B%B0%EF%BC%9A%E8%8B%A5%E7%88%BE%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E8%BF%A6%E8%91%89%E5%95%8F%E4%B8%AD%EF%BC%8C%E4%BD%9B%E8%AA%AA%EF%BC%9A%E3%80%8C%E6%88%91%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E9%82%8A%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E6%88%91%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E9%82%8A%EF%BC%8C%E9%9B%A2%E6%AD%A4%E4%BA%8C%E9%82%8A%EF%BC%8C%E5%90%8D%E7%82%BA%E4%B8%AD%E9%81%93%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D%E4%BB%8A%E4%BA%91%E4%BD%95%E8%A8%80%E7%84%A1%E6%88%91%E6%98%AF%E5%AF%A6%EF%BC%8C%E6%9C%89%E6%88%91%E7%82%BA%E6%96%B9%E4%BE%BF%E8%AA%AA%EF%BC%9F)
            187. [問曰：若無無常，無罪無福，無生無死，無縛無解。罪名煞等十不善道。若無無常，無煞等罪，如分別邪見中說：「刀在身七分中過，無所惱害。」福名不煞等十善道，無常名分別生死。若無無常，亦無生死，亦無縛，亦無解，如是等無量過咎。](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/295%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9A%E7%8E%8B%20%E7%A9%86%E6%8F%90%20.md#%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B#%E5%95%8F%E6%9B%B0%EF%BC%9A%E8%8B%A5%E7%84%A1%E7%84%A1%E5%B8%B8%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E7%BD%AA%E7%84%A1%E7%A6%8F%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E7%94%9F%E7%84%A1%E6%AD%BB%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E7%B8%9B%E7%84%A1%E8%A7%A3%E3%80%82%E7%BD%AA%E5%90%8D%E7%85%9E%E7%AD%89%E5%8D%81%E4%B8%8D%E5%96%84%E9%81%93%E3%80%82%E8%8B%A5%E7%84%A1%E7%84%A1%E5%B8%B8%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E7%85%9E%E7%AD%89%E7%BD%AA%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E5%88%86%E5%88%A5%E9%82%AA%E8%A6%8B%E4%B8%AD%E8%AA%AA%EF%BC%9A%E3%80%8C%E5%88%80%E5%9C%A8%E8%BA%AB%E4%B8%83%E5%88%86%E4%B8%AD%E9%81%8E%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E6%89%80%E6%83%B1%E5%AE%B3%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D%E7%A6%8F%E5%90%8D%E4%B8%8D%E7%85%9E%E7%AD%89%E5%8D%81%E5%96%84%E9%81%93%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E5%B8%B8%E5%90%8D%E5%88%86%E5%88%A5%E7%94%9F%E6%AD%BB%E3%80%82%E8%8B%A5%E7%84%A1%E7%84%A1%E5%B8%B8%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%A6%E7%84%A1%E7%94%9F%E6%AD%BB%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%A6%E7%84%A1%E7%B8%9B%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%A6%E7%84%A1%E8%A7%A3%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E6%98%AF%E7%AD%89%E7%84%A1%E9%87%8F%E9%81%8E%E5%92%8E%E3%80%82)
            188. [問曰：無漏智各各有所緣，無有能悉緣一切法者；唯有世俗智能緣一切法，以是故說，一切智是有漏相。](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/295%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9A%E7%8E%8B%20%E7%A9%86%E6%8F%90%20.md#%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B#%E5%95%8F%E6%9B%B0%EF%BC%9A%E7%84%A1%E6%BC%8F%E6%99%BA%E5%90%84%E5%90%84%E6%9C%89%E6%89%80%E7%B7%A3%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%A1%E6%9C%89%E8%83%BD%E6%82%89%E7%B7%A3%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%B3%95%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9B%E5%94%AF%E6%9C%89%E4%B8%96%E4%BF%97%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%B3%95%EF%BC%8C%E4%BB%A5%E6%98%AF%E6%95%85%E8%AA%AA%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%99%BA%E6%98%AF%E6%9C%89%E6%BC%8F%E7%9B%B8%E3%80%82)
            189. [問曰：菩薩若觀諸法畢竟空，內無吾我，已破憍慢，云何欲令諸佛稱讚其名？又菩薩法應供養諸佛，云何反求諸佛供養？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/295%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9A%E7%8E%8B%20%E7%A9%86%E6%8F%90%20.md#%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B#%E5%95%8F%E6%9B%B0%EF%BC%9A%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%8B%A5%E8%A7%80%E8%AB%B8%E6%B3%95%E7%95%A2%E7%AB%9F%E7%A9%BA%EF%BC%8C%E5%85%A7%E7%84%A1%E5%90%BE%E6%88%91%EF%BC%8C%E5%B7%B2%E7%A0%B4%E6%86%8D%E6%85%A2%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%91%E4%BD%95%E6%AC%B2%E4%BB%A4%E8%AB%B8%E4%BD%9B%E7%A8%B1%E8%AE%9A%E5%85%B6%E5%90%8D%EF%BC%9F%E5%8F%88%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E6%B3%95%E6%87%89%E4%BE%9B%E9%A4%8A%E8%AB%B8%E4%BD%9B%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%91%E4%BD%95%E5%8F%8D%E6%B1%82%E8%AB%B8%E4%BD%9B%E4%BE%9B%E9%A4%8A%EF%BC%9F)
            190.             191.             192.             193.             194. [問：唯識宗不談大悲心，不如入論？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/295%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%EF%BC%9A%E7%8E%8B%20%E7%A9%86%E6%8F%90%20.md#%E3%80%8A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%A6%81%E7%BE%A9%E5%95%8F%E7%AD%94%E3%80%8B#%E5%95%8F%EF%BC%9A%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E5%AE%97%E4%B8%8D%E8%AB%87%E5%A4%A7%E6%82%B2%E5%BF%83%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%8D%E5%A6%82%E5%85%A5%E8%AB%96%EF%BC%9F)
            195. [問︰《華嚴》第八〈十住品〉頌云︰「第四生貴真佛子，從諸賢聖正法生，有無諸法無所著，捨離生死出三界。」彼經第九又解十住初心菩薩，餘住亦爾。頌云︰「清淨妙法身，應現種種形，猶如大幻師，所樂無不現。或處為眾生，究竟菩薩行；或復現初生，出家行學道；或於樹王下，自然成正覺；或處為眾生，示現入泥洹。」如何此文言「多住外門修菩薩行」？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/000.00%20%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0/%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E5%8D%B7%E7%AC%AC%E4%B9%9D%E6%9C%AB.md#%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8A%E8%8F%AF%E5%9A%B4%E3%80%8B%E7%AC%AC%E5%85%AB%E3%80%88%E5%8D%81%E4%BD%8F%E5%93%81%E3%80%89%E9%A0%8C%E4%BA%91%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8C%E7%AC%AC%E5%9B%9B%E7%94%9F%E8%B2%B4%E7%9C%9F%E4%BD%9B%E5%AD%90%EF%BC%8C%E5%BE%9E%E8%AB%B8%E8%B3%A2%E8%81%96%E6%AD%A3%E6%B3%95%E7%94%9F%EF%BC%8C%E6%9C%89%E7%84%A1%E8%AB%B8%E6%B3%95%E7%84%A1%E6%89%80%E8%91%97%EF%BC%8C%E6%8D%A8%E9%9B%A2%E7%94%9F%E6%AD%BB%E5%87%BA%E4%B8%89%E7%95%8C%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D%E5%BD%BC%E7%B6%93%E7%AC%AC%E4%B9%9D%E5%8F%88%E8%A7%A3%E5%8D%81%E4%BD%8F%E5%88%9D%E5%BF%83%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%EF%BC%8C%E9%A4%98%E4%BD%8F%E4%BA%A6%E7%88%BE%E3%80%82%E9%A0%8C%E4%BA%91%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8C%E6%B8%85%E6%B7%A8%E5%A6%99%E6%B3%95%E8%BA%AB%EF%BC%8C%E6%87%89%E7%8F%BE%E7%A8%AE%E7%A8%AE%E5%BD%A2%EF%BC%8C%E7%8C%B6%E5%A6%82%E5%A4%A7%E5%B9%BB%E5%B8%AB%EF%BC%8C%E6%89%80%E6%A8%82%E7%84%A1%E4%B8%8D%E7%8F%BE%E3%80%82%E6%88%96%E8%99%95%E7%82%BA%E7%9C%BE%E7%94%9F%EF%BC%8C%E7%A9%B6%E7%AB%9F%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%A1%8C%EF%BC%9B%E6%88%96%E5%BE%A9%E7%8F%BE%E5%88%9D%E7%94%9F%EF%BC%8C%E5%87%BA%E5%AE%B6%E8%A1%8C%E5%AD%B8%E9%81%93%EF%BC%9B%E6%88%96%E6%96%BC%E6%A8%B9%E7%8E%8B%E4%B8%8B%EF%BC%8C%E8%87%AA%E7%84%B6%E6%88%90%E6%AD%A3%E8%A6%BA%EF%BC%9B%E6%88%96%E8%99%95%E7%82%BA%E7%9C%BE%E7%94%9F%EF%BC%8C%E7%A4%BA%E7%8F%BE%E5%85%A5%E6%B3%A5%E6%B4%B9%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E6%AD%A4%E6%96%87%E8%A8%80%E3%80%8C%E5%A4%9A%E4%BD%8F%E5%A4%96%E9%96%80%E4%BF%AE%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%A1%8C%E3%80%8D%EF%BC%9F)

                63.                 65. [**問︰此言斷者，為總緣智能斷，為別緣智能斷？此有何失？總緣之智非自相智，如何共相比量之智能斷惑耶？若別相智能斷，即違《對法》、五十九等文。《對法》七等說︰「問︰何等作意能斷耶？答︰總緣作意，觀一切法皆無我性，能斷煩惱。師子覺云︰總緣作意者，合緣一切法共相行作意。」**](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/000.00%20%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0/%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E5%8D%B7%E7%AC%AC%E5%8D%81%E6%9C%AC.md#**%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E6%AD%A4%E8%A8%80%E6%96%B7%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E7%82%BA%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%8C%E7%82%BA%E5%88%A5%E7%B7%A3%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%9F%E6%AD%A4%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%A4%B1%EF%BC%9F%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%B9%8B%E6%99%BA%E9%9D%9E%E8%87%AA%E7%9B%B8%E6%99%BA%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E5%85%B1%E7%9B%B8%E6%AF%94%E9%87%8F%E4%B9%8B%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E6%83%91%E8%80%B6%EF%BC%9F%E8%8B%A5%E5%88%A5%E7%9B%B8%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%8C%E5%8D%B3%E9%81%95%E3%80%8A%E5%B0%8D%E6%B3%95%E3%80%8B%E3%80%81%E4%BA%94%E5%8D%81%E4%B9%9D%E7%AD%89%E6%96%87%E3%80%82%E3%80%8A%E5%B0%8D%E6%B3%95%E3%80%8B%E4%B8%83%E7%AD%89%E8%AA%AA%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8C%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E4%BD%95%E7%AD%89%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E8%80%B6%EF%BC%9F%E7%AD%94%EF%B8%B0%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%EF%BC%8C%E8%A7%80%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%B3%95%E7%9A%86%E7%84%A1%E6%88%91%E6%80%A7%EF%BC%8C%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E7%85%A9%E6%83%B1%E3%80%82%E5%B8%AB%E5%AD%90%E8%A6%BA%E4%BA%91%EF%B8%B0%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E5%90%88%E7%B7%A3%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%B3%95%E5%85%B1%E7%9B%B8%E8%A1%8C%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D**)
                66.             599.             600. [問︰有漏種中有三界種，如在欲界，上界善等種不離於識體，即名無記性，體不離於識，應名欲界繫。此義應思。](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/310%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B.md#%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E6%9C%89%E6%BC%8F%E7%A8%AE%E4%B8%AD%E6%9C%89%E4%B8%89%E7%95%8C%E7%A8%AE%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E5%9C%A8%E6%AC%B2%E7%95%8C%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%8A%E7%95%8C%E5%96%84%E7%AD%89%E7%A8%AE%E4%B8%8D%E9%9B%A2%E6%96%BC%E8%AD%98%E9%AB%94%EF%BC%8C%E5%8D%B3%E5%90%8D%E7%84%A1%E8%A8%98%E6%80%A7%EF%BC%8C%E9%AB%94%E4%B8%8D%E9%9B%A2%E6%96%BC%E8%AD%98%EF%BC%8C%E6%87%89%E5%90%8D%E6%AC%B2%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%E3%80%82%E6%AD%A4%E7%BE%A9%E6%87%89%E6%80%9D%E3%80%82)
            602. [問︰大乘所緣，本是心變，隨心何繫，地境亦隨之故。如在欲界，命終生上，此潤生愛，是上界繫。依欲界身，緣欲界身，仍「相分」中所變，「相分」是上界繫，隨見心說。第七緣第八「相分」亦然。何故不如此中緣種，境是異界繫，心是異界繫？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/310%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B.md#%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E5%A4%A7%E4%B9%98%E6%89%80%E7%B7%A3%EF%BC%8C%E6%9C%AC%E6%98%AF%E5%BF%83%E8%AE%8A%EF%BC%8C%E9%9A%A8%E5%BF%83%E4%BD%95%E7%B9%AB%EF%BC%8C%E5%9C%B0%E5%A2%83%E4%BA%A6%E9%9A%A8%E4%B9%8B%E6%95%85%E3%80%82%E5%A6%82%E5%9C%A8%E6%AC%B2%E7%95%8C%EF%BC%8C%E5%91%BD%E7%B5%82%E7%94%9F%E4%B8%8A%EF%BC%8C%E6%AD%A4%E6%BD%A4%E7%94%9F%E6%84%9B%EF%BC%8C%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%8A%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%E3%80%82%E4%BE%9D%E6%AC%B2%E7%95%8C%E8%BA%AB%EF%BC%8C%E7%B7%A3%E6%AC%B2%E7%95%8C%E8%BA%AB%EF%BC%8C%E4%BB%8D%E3%80%8C%E7%9B%B8%E5%88%86%E3%80%8D%E4%B8%AD%E6%89%80%E8%AE%8A%EF%BC%8C%E3%80%8C%E7%9B%B8%E5%88%86%E3%80%8D%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%8A%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%EF%BC%8C%E9%9A%A8%E8%A6%8B%E5%BF%83%E8%AA%AA%E3%80%82%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%83%E7%B7%A3%E7%AC%AC%E5%85%AB%E3%80%8C%E7%9B%B8%E5%88%86%E3%80%8D%E4%BA%A6%E7%84%B6%E3%80%82%E4%BD%95%E6%95%85%E4%B8%8D%E5%A6%82%E6%AD%A4%E4%B8%AD%E7%B7%A3%E7%A8%AE%EF%BC%8C%E5%A2%83%E6%98%AF%E7%95%B0%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%EF%BC%8C%E5%BF%83%E6%98%AF%E7%95%B0%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%EF%BC%9F)

            606. [問︰《華嚴》第八〈十住品〉頌云︰「第四生貴真佛子，從諸賢聖正法生，有無諸法無所著，捨離生死出三界。」彼經第九又解十住初心菩薩，餘住亦爾。頌云︰「清淨妙法身，應現種種形，猶如大幻師，所樂無不現。或處為眾生，究竟菩薩行；或復現初生，出家行學道；或於樹王下，自然成正覺；或處為眾生，示現入泥洹。」如何此文言「多住外門修菩薩行」？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/310%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B.md#%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8A%E8%8F%AF%E5%9A%B4%E3%80%8B%E7%AC%AC%E5%85%AB%E3%80%88%E5%8D%81%E4%BD%8F%E5%93%81%E3%80%89%E9%A0%8C%E4%BA%91%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8C%E7%AC%AC%E5%9B%9B%E7%94%9F%E8%B2%B4%E7%9C%9F%E4%BD%9B%E5%AD%90%EF%BC%8C%E5%BE%9E%E8%AB%B8%E8%B3%A2%E8%81%96%E6%AD%A3%E6%B3%95%E7%94%9F%EF%BC%8C%E6%9C%89%E7%84%A1%E8%AB%B8%E6%B3%95%E7%84%A1%E6%89%80%E8%91%97%EF%BC%8C%E6%8D%A8%E9%9B%A2%E7%94%9F%E6%AD%BB%E5%87%BA%E4%B8%89%E7%95%8C%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D%E5%BD%BC%E7%B6%93%E7%AC%AC%E4%B9%9D%E5%8F%88%E8%A7%A3%E5%8D%81%E4%BD%8F%E5%88%9D%E5%BF%83%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%EF%BC%8C%E9%A4%98%E4%BD%8F%E4%BA%A6%E7%88%BE%E3%80%82%E9%A0%8C%E4%BA%91%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8C%E6%B8%85%E6%B7%A8%E5%A6%99%E6%B3%95%E8%BA%AB%EF%BC%8C%E6%87%89%E7%8F%BE%E7%A8%AE%E7%A8%AE%E5%BD%A2%EF%BC%8C%E7%8C%B6%E5%A6%82%E5%A4%A7%E5%B9%BB%E5%B8%AB%EF%BC%8C%E6%89%80%E6%A8%82%E7%84%A1%E4%B8%8D%E7%8F%BE%E3%80%82%E6%88%96%E8%99%95%E7%82%BA%E7%9C%BE%E7%94%9F%EF%BC%8C%E7%A9%B6%E7%AB%9F%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%A1%8C%EF%BC%9B%E6%88%96%E5%BE%A9%E7%8F%BE%E5%88%9D%E7%94%9F%EF%BC%8C%E5%87%BA%E5%AE%B6%E8%A1%8C%E5%AD%B8%E9%81%93%EF%BC%9B%E6%88%96%E6%96%BC%E6%A8%B9%E7%8E%8B%E4%B8%8B%EF%BC%8C%E8%87%AA%E7%84%B6%E6%88%90%E6%AD%A3%E8%A6%BA%EF%BC%9B%E6%88%96%E8%99%95%E7%82%BA%E7%9C%BE%E7%94%9F%EF%BC%8C%E7%A4%BA%E7%8F%BE%E5%85%A5%E6%B3%A5%E6%B4%B9%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E6%AD%A4%E6%96%87%E8%A8%80%E3%80%8C%E5%A4%9A%E4%BD%8F%E5%A4%96%E9%96%80%E4%BF%AE%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%A1%8C%E3%80%8D%EF%BC%9F)

[**問︰此言斷者，為總緣智能斷，為別緣智能斷？此有何失？總緣之智非自相智，如何共相比量之智能斷惑耶？若別相智能斷，即違《對法》、五十九等文。《對法》七等說︰「問︰何等作意能斷耶？答︰總緣作意，觀一切法皆無我性，能斷煩惱。師子覺云︰總緣作意者，合緣一切法共相行作意。」**](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/310%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B.md#**%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E6%AD%A4%E8%A8%80%E6%96%B7%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E7%82%BA%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%8C%E7%82%BA%E5%88%A5%E7%B7%A3%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%9F%E6%AD%A4%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%A4%B1%EF%BC%9F%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%B9%8B%E6%99%BA%E9%9D%9E%E8%87%AA%E7%9B%B8%E6%99%BA%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E5%85%B1%E7%9B%B8%E6%AF%94%E9%87%8F%E4%B9%8B%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E6%83%91%E8%80%B6%EF%BC%9F%E8%8B%A5%E5%88%A5%E7%9B%B8%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%8C%E5%8D%B3%E9%81%95%E3%80%8A%E5%B0%8D%E6%B3%95%E3%80%8B%E3%80%81%E4%BA%94%E5%8D%81%E4%B9%9D%E7%AD%89%E6%96%87%E3%80%82%E3%80%8A%E5%B0%8D%E6%B3%95%E3%80%8B%E4%B8%83%E7%AD%89%E8%AA%AA%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8C%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E4%BD%95%E7%AD%89%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E8%80%B6%EF%BC%9F%E7%AD%94%EF%B8%B0%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%EF%BC%8C%E8%A7%80%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%B3%95%E7%9A%86%E7%84%A1%E6%88%91%E6%80%A7%EF%BC%8C%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E7%85%A9%E6%83%B1%E3%80%82%E5%B8%AB%E5%AD%90%E8%A6%BA%E4%BA%91%EF%B8%B0%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E5%90%88%E7%B7%A3%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%B3%95%E5%85%B1%E7%9B%B8%E8%A1%8C%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D**)

            602. [問︰大乘所緣，本是心變，隨心何繫，地境亦隨之故。如在欲界，命終生上，此潤生愛，是上界繫。依欲界身，緣欲界身，仍「相分」中所變，「相分」是上界繫，隨見心說。第七緣第八「相分」亦然。何故不如此中緣種，境是異界繫，心是異界繫？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/310%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B%EF%BC%88%E4%B8%8A%EF%BC%89.md#%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E5%A4%A7%E4%B9%98%E6%89%80%E7%B7%A3%EF%BC%8C%E6%9C%AC%E6%98%AF%E5%BF%83%E8%AE%8A%EF%BC%8C%E9%9A%A8%E5%BF%83%E4%BD%95%E7%B9%AB%EF%BC%8C%E5%9C%B0%E5%A2%83%E4%BA%A6%E9%9A%A8%E4%B9%8B%E6%95%85%E3%80%82%E5%A6%82%E5%9C%A8%E6%AC%B2%E7%95%8C%EF%BC%8C%E5%91%BD%E7%B5%82%E7%94%9F%E4%B8%8A%EF%BC%8C%E6%AD%A4%E6%BD%A4%E7%94%9F%E6%84%9B%EF%BC%8C%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%8A%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%E3%80%82%E4%BE%9D%E6%AC%B2%E7%95%8C%E8%BA%AB%EF%BC%8C%E7%B7%A3%E6%AC%B2%E7%95%8C%E8%BA%AB%EF%BC%8C%E4%BB%8D%E3%80%8C%E7%9B%B8%E5%88%86%E3%80%8D%E4%B8%AD%E6%89%80%E8%AE%8A%EF%BC%8C%E3%80%8C%E7%9B%B8%E5%88%86%E3%80%8D%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%8A%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%EF%BC%8C%E9%9A%A8%E8%A6%8B%E5%BF%83%E8%AA%AA%E3%80%82%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%83%E7%B7%A3%E7%AC%AC%E5%85%AB%E3%80%8C%E7%9B%B8%E5%88%86%E3%80%8D%E4%BA%A6%E7%84%B6%E3%80%82%E4%BD%95%E6%95%85%E4%B8%8D%E5%A6%82%E6%AD%A4%E4%B8%AD%E7%B7%A3%E7%A8%AE%EF%BC%8C%E5%A2%83%E6%98%AF%E7%95%B0%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%EF%BC%8C%E5%BF%83%E6%98%AF%E7%95%B0%E7%95%8C%E7%B9%AB%EF%BC%9F)

[問︰若爾，諸得此定，必是不還已去生無色聖者，必非不定性聖者。是定性人，聖不下生故。非不定人先根熟時，佛不救故，亦非不定性人大根必不熟入無餘。義如第八十〈無餘依地〉說。與定性人有何別？故即彼定性人，如何信有第八識也？菩薩又不生彼。若信大乘，便非定性，不應生彼；若定性者，云何信有？](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/310%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B%EF%BC%88%E4%B8%8B%EF%BC%89.md#%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E8%8B%A5%E7%88%BE%EF%BC%8C%E8%AB%B8%E5%BE%97%E6%AD%A4%E5%AE%9A%EF%BC%8C%E5%BF%85%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%8D%E9%82%84%E5%B7%B2%E5%8E%BB%E7%94%9F%E7%84%A1%E8%89%B2%E8%81%96%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E5%BF%85%E9%9D%9E%E4%B8%8D%E5%AE%9A%E6%80%A7%E8%81%96%E8%80%85%E3%80%82%E6%98%AF%E5%AE%9A%E6%80%A7%E4%BA%BA%EF%BC%8C%E8%81%96%E4%B8%8D%E4%B8%8B%E7%94%9F%E6%95%85%E3%80%82%E9%9D%9E%E4%B8%8D%E5%AE%9A%E4%BA%BA%E5%85%88%E6%A0%B9%E7%86%9F%E6%99%82%EF%BC%8C%E4%BD%9B%E4%B8%8D%E6%95%91%E6%95%85%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%A6%E9%9D%9E%E4%B8%8D%E5%AE%9A%E6%80%A7%E4%BA%BA%E5%A4%A7%E6%A0%B9%E5%BF%85%E4%B8%8D%E7%86%9F%E5%85%A5%E7%84%A1%E9%A4%98%E3%80%82%E7%BE%A9%E5%A6%82%E7%AC%AC%E5%85%AB%E5%8D%81%E3%80%88%E7%84%A1%E9%A4%98%E4%BE%9D%E5%9C%B0%E3%80%89%E8%AA%AA%E3%80%82%E8%88%87%E5%AE%9A%E6%80%A7%E4%BA%BA%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%88%A5%EF%BC%9F%E6%95%85%E5%8D%B3%E5%BD%BC%E5%AE%9A%E6%80%A7%E4%BA%BA%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E4%BF%A1%E6%9C%89%E7%AC%AC%E5%85%AB%E8%AD%98%E4%B9%9F%EF%BC%9F%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E5%8F%88%E4%B8%8D%E7%94%9F%E5%BD%BC%E3%80%82%E8%8B%A5%E4%BF%A1%E5%A4%A7%E4%B9%98%EF%BC%8C%E4%BE%BF%E9%9D%9E%E5%AE%9A%E6%80%A7%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%8D%E6%87%89%E7%94%9F%E5%BD%BC%EF%BC%9B%E8%8B%A5%E5%AE%9A%E6%80%A7%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E4%BA%91%E4%BD%95%E4%BF%A1%E6%9C%89%EF%BC%9F)

            643. [**問︰此言斷者，為總緣智能斷，為別緣智能斷？此有何失？總緣之智非自相智，如何共相比量之智能斷惑耶？若別相智能斷，即違《對法》、五十九等文。《對法》七等說︰「問︰何等作意能斷耶？答︰總緣作意，觀一切法皆無我性，能斷煩惱。師子覺云︰總緣作意者，合緣一切法共相行作意。」**](/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A6%BA%E8%97%8F%E9%9B%86/06-%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9%E8%97%8F/310%20%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B/310%E3%80%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E8%AD%98%E8%AB%96%E8%BF%B0%E8%A8%98%E8%AB%96%E8%AD%B0%E3%80%8B%EF%BC%88%E4%B8%8B%EF%BC%89.md#**%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E6%AD%A4%E8%A8%80%E6%96%B7%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E7%82%BA%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%8C%E7%82%BA%E5%88%A5%E7%B7%A3%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%9F%E6%AD%A4%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%A4%B1%EF%BC%9F%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%B9%8B%E6%99%BA%E9%9D%9E%E8%87%AA%E7%9B%B8%E6%99%BA%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E5%85%B1%E7%9B%B8%E6%AF%94%E9%87%8F%E4%B9%8B%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E6%83%91%E8%80%B6%EF%BC%9F%E8%8B%A5%E5%88%A5%E7%9B%B8%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%EF%BC%8C%E5%8D%B3%E9%81%95%E3%80%8A%E5%B0%8D%E6%B3%95%E3%80%8B%E3%80%81%E4%BA%94%E5%8D%81%E4%B9%9D%E7%AD%89%E6%96%87%E3%80%82%E3%80%8A%E5%B0%8D%E6%B3%95%E3%80%8B%E4%B8%83%E7%AD%89%E8%AA%AA%EF%B8%B0%E3%80%8C%E5%95%8F%EF%B8%B0%E4%BD%95%E7%AD%89%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E8%80%B6%EF%BC%9F%E7%AD%94%EF%B8%B0%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%EF%BC%8C%E8%A7%80%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%B3%95%E7%9A%86%E7%84%A1%E6%88%91%E6%80%A7%EF%BC%8C%E8%83%BD%E6%96%B7%E7%85%A9%E6%83%B1%E3%80%82%E5%B8%AB%E5%AD%90%E8%A6%BA%E4%BA%91%EF%B8%B0%E7%B8%BD%E7%B7%A3%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E8%80%85%EF%BC%8C%E5%90%88%E7%B7%A3%E4%B8%80%E5%88%87%E6%B3%95%E5%85%B1%E7%9B%B8%E8%A1%8C%E4%BD%9C%E6%84%8F%E3%80%82%E3%80%8D**)
